# A customer's overpayment applied to no invoice: a transaction with no
# `payment:` block and no `lot_owner:`, so its receivable split is in no lot.
#
# The 100.00 USD goes into the USD bank, which grows: an asset cost basis of
# the dollars held. The receivable's credit takes the receivable from nothing
# to −100.00, owed back to the customer: a liability cost basis (Q-054). Each
# is 100.00 at 1.40, the rate the transaction states.
#
# What this fixture produces: `fx-balances` lists both, 100.00 USD held and
# 100.00 USD owed, the same as a prepayment in a lot of the customer's
# (fx_refund_usd_prepayment.txt).
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_foreign_currency_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-02-01 * "Customer overpaid, applied to no invoice"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank:USD 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "140.00"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable USD -100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "1.40"
		value: "-140.00"
